title: Routing decision contextualizer with cost and rationale tags
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Summary:
We want to attach lightweight, human-readable context to routing decisions to improve debuggability and cost visibility when the smart router selects region/tier/model-variant fallbacks. The core idea is a 'decision contextualizer' that enriches per-decision logs and sampled traces with three compact fields: (1) rationale_tags (short summary tokens), (2) cost_estimate_units (approx cost delta for the chosen route), and (3) sampling_hint (why this decision was captured).

Background and motivation:
Current decision traces capture route hops and verdicts but lack a normalized, searchable explanation and immediate cost signal. SREs and product engineers spend time joining event streams to cost telemetry and reading raw policy rules to understand why a fallback or cross-region choice happened. This ticket defines the schema, sampling policy, and Console surface changes to add contextual metadata to routing events with minimal overhead and configurable retention.

Proposal (high level):
1) Add a small, versioned envelope to routing decision events emitted from the router: decision_context_v1 with three fields: rationale_tags, cost_estimate_units, sampling_hint. Rationale_tags are 1-4 short tokens (e.g., "region-healthy", "tier-fallback", "quota-exceeded", "quantized-variant"). cost_estimate_units is an integer bucket (e.g., 1..100) representing relative per-request token-cost impact. sampling_hint is a single token describing capture reason (e.g., "anomaly-sampled", "progressive-canary", "always-capture-slow-path"). The envelope is only added to sampled events to keep event size bounded.
2) Instrument router to produce a concise natural-language rationale string at decision time and derive rationale_tags via a rules->tag mapping. Keep NL rationale optional and only for debug capture.
3) Surface tags and cost buckets in Console's route inspector and decision-playback UI with filters (by tag, cost bucket, sampling_hint).

Event format (example lines for implementation):
- decision_context_version: "v1"
- rationale_tags: "tier-fallback,region-degraded"
- cost_estimate_units: "7"
- sampling_hint: "replay-sample"
- optional_rationale_text: "primary region us-west3 exceeded soft latency SLO, routed to dedicated-tier-2 with quantized model v2q"

Sampling policy and cadence:
- Base sampling: 0.5% of all decisions across the fleet (configurable per customer/tier).
- Targeted sampling: 100% of decisions that trigger a fallback to lower-tier model-variant or cross-region (to ensure fallbacks are fully auditable).
- Anomaly-based sampling: dynamic uplift when latency or error rates spike (hooked into existing SLO alarms).
- Canaries: during rollouts we mark all decisions with sampling_hint "canary" for the rollout window.

Storage/retention and cost controls:
- Sampled decision_context events stored in our observability pipeline for 30d by default for P0/P1 customers, 7d for self-serve. Provide compacted index in Console for 90d with only tags and cost buckets (no NL rationale).
- Because cost_estimate_units is a small integer, the envelope stays under a small size budget. We will add a config knob to disable optional_rationale_text for customers on tight egress budgets.

Console UX changes (summary):
- Add "Decision context" panel to route inspector showing rationale_tags (pill UI), cost bucket visualization, and sampling_hint with a link to the sampled trace payload.
- New filters on Decision Explorer: by tag, by cost bucket (>X), by sampling_hint.
- Playback: show a compact timeline line with tagged hops and the reason summary on hover.

Rollout plan and phases:
- Spike (this ticket): design and implement decision_context_v1, unit tests, add metrics for event emission rates.
- Pilot: enable targeted sampling for a small set of customers and internal traffic; iterate on tags mapping.
- Larger rollout: enable default sampling for all P1 customers; expose knobs in Console and API.
- Complete: publish docs and migration notes for ops teams and partner engineers.

Metrics and success criteria:
- time_to_triage: median time to identify routing cause for fallback incidents reduced by 40% in pilot customers (measured in internal playbook runs).
- inspection_success_rate: percentage of incidents where decision_context provided sufficient info for root-cause > 85%.
- emission_overhead: additional telemetry bytes per sampled event < 1.2KB on average.

Risks and mitigations:
- Privacy/PII: ensure rationale_text never contains user prompt data; run sanitizer.
- Storage explosion: default to conservative sampling and compacted index; provide per-customer caps.
- Misleading cost buckets: calibrate cost_estimate_units with Runtime costing team and add labels explaining the units.

Open questions:
- Should rationale_tags be derived by router rules only, or can downstream policy engines append tags? (Prefer router-only for determinism; allow downstream tags under a namespace).
- How to version tags for long-lived dashboards? We'll publish a tag->description registry in Console and make tag names stable across versions.

Deliverables for this ticket:
- decision_context_v1 proto/text spec in repo and Confluence doc (public link in attachments).
- Router code changes to emit envelope behind a feature flag.
- Basic Console panel for sampled decision inspection and filters.
- Unit/integration tests and a small load test validating emission rate under peak.

Estimated implementation effort: 5 points (router changes + Console minimal UI + tests + pilot).
acceptance_criteria: decision_context_v1 spec added to repo and Confluence with examples and tag registry
Router emits decision_context for targeted fallback events when feature flag is on; emission rate measured and within budget
Console shows Decision Context panel with rationale_tags, cost_estimate_units, and sampling_hint for sampled events
Pilot customers enabled and playbook shows >40% reduction in triage time in at least 3 pilots
